scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false), not the author's working copy. QGIS 4 plugin with a Processing provider, not a web service: no HTTP routes. The Makefile was skimmed only (shell/make is out of scope for full detection in skill version 1.0). Secret-pattern hits were all in tests/ (redaction test fixtures and one fixture builder) and are recorded as low placeholders; core/redact.py is code that removes credentials from output. Generated fixtures and images excluded. Interactive-looking matches such as os.system in tests/qgis/test_rebuild.py:213 are a hostile-input test string, not executed code.

python.package_manager: none (plugin zip built by scripts/build_plugin.py; CI uses uv ephemeral environments)
findings: No requirements/pyproject manifest; runtime depends only on the Python standard library plus QGIS 4 (DESIGN.md states no third-party dependencies)
CI installs pytest unpinned and jsonschema==4.23.0, detect-secrets unpinned, via uv --with

proper_secret_handling_found.mechanism: credentials (passwords, tokens, Authorization headers, authcfg) are redacted from datasource URIs and project XML before output; redact option defaults on
detect-secrets scan in CI and release workflows; # pragma: allowlist secret on fixtures

entry_points.framework: QGIS Processing (Document project, Rebuild project from JSON)

interfaces.network_binding: none observed (no listening socket and no outbound HTTP code in the plugin; web services and databases are not contacted by default)

file_system_access.detail: OutputFolder writes reports/JSON/images/QML/QPT into a user-chosen folder with a manifest and symlink/overwrite protections; never replaces files it did not write unless overwrite=true
reads the open QGIS project or a .qgz/.qgs project file; opens local data for counts and extents (load_data default on)
rebuild_project writes a new .qgz from project.json

what_this_app_can_do: Reads a QGIS project and writes Markdown, HTML, PDF and JSON documentation (layers, styles, layouts, settings) into a folder the user chooses, with credentials redacted by default.
Rebuilds a new QGIS project file from the generated JSON, optionally remapping data folders and attaching QGIS auth configs.
Optionally captures screenshots of QGIS dialogs, skipping pages that show data sources or logins.

data_sources_touched.source: Local QGIS project files (.qgz/.qgs) and the datasets they reference (for counts and extents)
Output folder on local disk (reports, JSON, images, QML, QPT, rebuilt .qgz)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Runs locally inside QGIS (dialog, Processing toolbox, Python console). No network listener or outbound network code found.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: With redact=false or paths=absolute the generated reports/JSON could contain credentials or full home-folder paths; both default to safe values
Generated JSON embeds the project's data-source list, which could reveal internal server names

top_findings: Two placeholder passwords in test fixtures (low, allowlisted for detect-secrets)
.gitignore does not exclude .env / key / credential files
No routes, no network code, no database access found; credentials are redacted from outputs by design
